description: This PHP source file defines the class EmailsControllerActionGetFromFields, which handles email-related actions such as retrieving email 'from' fields, preparing outbound email accounts, signatures, and encoding data for responses. It is part of the SuiteCRM project and integrates with email functionalities and user preferences.

classes.name: EmailsControllerActionGetFromFields
classes.description: Controller class managing email 'from' fields, signatures, and accounts for SuiteCRM users.

methods.name: handleActionGetFromFields
methods.description: Processes and retrieves email 'from' fields, signatures, and accounts, returning JSON data.

methods.name: getOutboundFromFields
methods.description: Returns JSON data for outbound email 'from' fields for the current user.

methods.name: getEmailSignatures
methods.description: Decodes and returns user email signatures or logs a warning if not available.

methods.name: getDefaultSignatures
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the default email signature for the current user.

methods.name: addOutboundEmailAccounts
methods.description: Appends user's outbound email account information, including signatures, to the provided data array.
